newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujisawa leaps on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Fujisawa leaps on earnings hopes.

text.p: Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd leapt in Wednesday morning trade, attracting investors seeking defensive stocks as well as those seeking shares of firms with bright earnings outlooks, brokers said.
As of 0123 GMT, the share was up 70 yen, or 5.79 percent, at 1,280. It was the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

"An increase in sales of PROGRAF is expected to improve the earnings of Fujisawa's units in the United States and Germany, which will boost the pharmaceutical firm's group earnings above its parent earnings," a source at SBC Warburg said.
"Group earnings are seen posting double-digit rises for the next four years."
PROGRAF is a drug used to prevent organ rejection in transplant patients.
SBC Warburg Securities has raised Fujisawa's rating from "hold" to "buy".
